owner.question: One more random lattice test failure needs a tolerance decision, like the one you approved for R29. `half_integer_sums_match_their_direct_sums_off_the_plane` compares the Ewald sum with a slower direct sum over lattice shells. In one case (degree 9, values near 3e11), one lattice image sits next to a zero of its angular factor, so rounding the unit vector by one ulp moves the result by 3.8e-12 relative. Against mpmath (40 digits): the Ewald path is off by 3.6e-13 relative, the direct-sum reference by 1.6e-12, and the tolerance is about 1e-12. So the code is right and the test's reference is the weaker path. The proposed fix adds 4 eps × Σ |r − R| |∇ term| over the shell terms to that test's tolerance: a rounding allowance that grows only where a term is this sensitive. Approve?

text: Fix now (Recommended)
owner.question: Lattice finding (b) is a real bug. The reciprocal Ewald sum picks its shell radius as if k·eta were real. When the split is turned off the real axis (here 37°), the terms decay ~4× more slowly than it assumes, so some sums stop at the shell limit with 'Ewald sum did not converge'. The fix takes the larger of the old radius and one computed from the actual decay. Where a sum converges today, nothing changes: every value byte-identical, and the bitwise, uf and hot checks unchanged. Only inputs that fail today change. 14 entries in the recorded lattice dump stored that error, and would now return values that the docs session checks against mpmath before anything is committed. The kit records those 14 as expected changes. Fix it in this round?

text: Approve (Recommended)
owner.question: Lattice finding (c) is a test issue, not a bug. In one case, both explicit-split paths differ from mpmath by 5.5e-11, because the reciprocal part's terms cancel by about 130× inside that part. The tolerance term you approved measures |real part| + |reciprocal part| and misses that. The proposed change measures 64 ulps of the largest single term within each part instead. Test-only, no computed values change. Approve this change to the approved term?
